findings.text: follow-on: _record_queued_failure catches only CrewError from runs._mutate_pointer, so any other write failure (for example OSError) escapes the finally at :334 and propagates out of admit_once, ending the admit service loop instead of recording the failure and continuing.

follow-on: on a local re-queue the result bookkeeping appends the superseded pointer["run_id"] to held/failed while the surviving queued pointer is the re-queued run id (held.queued["run_id"]), so crew admit reports a run id that no live pointer holds.
